final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_pd FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_rc AS avg_replacement_cost, avg_pd AS avg_per_day_price, avg_pd / (SELECT AVG(avg_pd) FROM r) AS ratio_to_mean_per_day FROM r ORDER BY rating
